entities.summary: Artemy Andreyevich Lebedev is a Russian designer, entrepreneur and Internet personality. He is the founder of the design company Art. Lebedev Studio. He is also an avid blogger, known for provocative views and frequent use of obscene language. Lebedev is a member of the Tolstoy family. Artemy Lebedev was a performers & entertainers from Moscow (b. 1975-02-13, Moscow). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to economic history and geopolitics.
